them float — the documentation trail for 'a newer version exists and we are not taking
it yet, here is why'. Enforced by scripts/security/check-pin-exceptions.mjs, which fails
when a pin or a dependabot ignore: rule exists with no entry here, and warns when an
TWO KINDS live here, and the difference matters:
kind=exact-pin  — the manifest declares an exact version (no ^ or ~). Dependabot still
proposes bumps; the pin only forces each one to arrive as a reviewable
PR instead of resolving silently on npm ci. Being at latest is normal.
kind=held-back  — we are actively refusing an available newer version, normally via a
dependabot ignore: rule. These are the ones that rot: every entry MUST
carry a review_by, and the lint warns once it passes.
This register does NOT cover two neighbouring cases that have their own files:
- overrides forcing a consumer off its declared range -> <workspace>/.override-range-baseline.json

exceptions.reason: Build-time dependency inside the desktop SIGNING path (desktop-release environment, Azure Trusted Signing, Apple notarization). A build dependency that floats on npm ci is a supply-chain exposure, not a convenience question, so every version change must arrive as a reviewable dependabot PR triaged through /weekly-deps. Consumed by the locally-owned Forge NSIS and DMG makers (build/makerNsis.ts, build/makerDmg.ts). Explicitly: do NOT relax to a caret.
